## Installation

Install as executable:

```shell
cargo install --locked rust-private-cli-template
```

Install as library dependency in your package:

```shell
cargo add rust-private-cli-template
```

## Usage

```shell
A template for creating Rust private CLI apps with Clap.

Usage: rust-private-cli-template <COMMAND>

Commands:
  print  
  help   Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
  -h, --help     Print help
  -V, --version  Print version
```
